## Notes

**What changed:** Don's change of 2026-10-31 (#1135) dropped the Rules page and the four-rule step. Publishing now shows one line, 'By posting you agree to the Terms', with no tick; `/rules` redirects to `/terms`; the photo rule sits in the Terms. The database side (version compared on every publish, one agreement row per Page, no peer reads it) is unchanged and its guards were updated in #1135 and still pass. The PR itself says 'Scenario F082 ... describes the old step and needs updating'; it has not been, and the scenario's `## Rulings` has no dated line, so I could not mark anything `retired`.

Criterion 2 is split: **2a** (agreeing is the whole step, nothing typed, uploaded or approved) stands; **2b** (fixed statements with a reason each) is a `spec-conflict`, built to a different design by the PM. Criterion 7 is read as 'the Terms are one click away' and is built; 5 has lost its guard; 2a and 7 lost their marked checks. **Cells moved from unmet to built or retired: none; checks that fell back: 2a, 5, 7.**

Reviewed: #326, #493 and #908 carry `Reviewed by:`, but #1135 (labelled `needs-fix`, 'second session pending') rewrote criteria 1, 2a, 5, 7 and 9, so those read no. #1181 (criterion 8's listing) carries a second-session review. Shipped: Deploy health green on 96b0ea6, f89b294, 3df9260, 591ab70. Smoked: smoke-live opened `root` and `explore` green on 11-06 (16:20 on baa096b, 16:52 on 9d61791) and red on the same commits later (sign-in stalls and timeouts); `page` was last opened 11-03 and was red. No green run covers a Page route after the last merge, so display criteria read unknown, down from yes on 10-23 [V gh run]. PM looked: no `uat` Issue; #519 has 0 of 22 ticked [V].

Filed (all `Gates: launch`, well-worn, tests only, `launch-blocking`, milestone Beta, `area:create-posts`): #1202 (guard criterion 5), #1203 (check criterion 2a), #1204 (check criterion 7).
